note: THE ORIENTATION ARM ON THE FULL TRAINING FOLD, SCORED ON THE FULL VALIDATION SET. Identical to 24u342 in every setting except the data: cross-seed softplus ranking loss at tau 0.0305 with --alpha-pae 0, distance AND orientation injected at all four pairformer blocks with untied per-block copies, --train-only 'linear_no_bias_d,pose_perblock,frame_dir' = 12 tensors / 44,032 parameters, --l2-sp-exclude 'frame_dir' leaving the 4 zero-init orientation tensors trainable but out of the anchor, lr 1e-2, warmup 20, --blocks-per-ckpt 0. TRAINING DATA: training/full_train (488 structures) instead of overfit30 (30), roughly 16x the units and 16x the optimiser steps per epoch, which is why this is 12 epochs rather than 50 -- on the order of 4x the total optimisation 24u342 received, with twelve held-out evaluations. HELD OUT: training/valfull (92 interfaces) instead of val10 (18). THESE TWO POOLS ARE NOT COMPARABLE and no number from any previous arm transfers to this one; shipped 0.2909 / 0.5556 are VAL10 figures. The reporting derives shipped from this run's own eval shards via their stored_iptm column, so the reference follows the pool automatically. WHY: six arms have ended at parity on val10 and every one of those nulls is ambiguous, because 30 structures was never enough to distinguish 'the reordering does not generalise' from 'the objective is wrong'. 24u342 made the case concrete -- training loss flat from epoch 9, frac pinned at 11/18 for fifteen epochs, and a stable 4-better/4-worse split across the eight hard interfaces that looks exactly like an un-generalised signal. If more data breaks that symmetry, the objective is fine and the pool was the limit; if the symmetry holds at 1,028 interfaces, the objective is the problem and no amount of data fixes it. Either answer is worth more than another overfit30 arm. LAMBDA was re-measured by a fresh --grad-probe on this data even though the parameter count is unchanged and the sqrt factor is exactly 1, because |g_rank| can differ on a new distribution. CRITERION: selected DockQ and fraction above 0.23 on the 92 valfull interfaces against shipped DERIVED FROM THIS RUN'S SHARDS. Spearman is reported but is NOT the criterion. CONTROL: 24u342, this arm on 30 structures scored on 18 interfaces.
